name: research
description: Design reproducible research software, integrate references, enforce matching uv environments, and synchronize, launch, track, and visualize experiments across GPU rigs.

interface.longDescription: Structure research projects, design experiments, integrate reference implementations through explicit source-to-target deviation approval, provision and verify exact uv environments, deploy tested Git revisions, dispatch GPU sweeps, reconcile run state, maintain a research journal, and create result visualizations.
defaultPrompt: Design a reproducible experiment and agree on its run identity.
Provision and verify one exact uv environment across configured GPU rigs.
Integrate reference code and approve every source-to-target deviation before editing.
Deploy, dispatch, and reconcile an approved experiment wave across GPU rigs.
